title: Lucid Energize Demo VHS 1993
summary: A 1993 VHS demo of Lucid Energize, a database-backed, incremental C/C++ programming environment built on XEmacs. It shows features like incremental compilation, live debugging and hyperlinked output.
why: HN cites it constantly as evidence that modern IDE and LSP-style features existed in the early 90s.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: the first IDE to offer something like LSP was a C++ one actually, Energize C++.
